design_philosophy: A fusion of luxury elegance, modern minimalism, and bold editorial. An architectural approach prioritizing heavy negative space, oversized serif typography paired with clean sans, and staggered, asymmetric imagery to convey high-end interior design and civil contracting.

typography.heading_strategy: Oversized, elegant serif. Use tracking-tighter for impact. Mix regular and italic weights within the same headline for a bold editorial feel.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, geometric but soft sans-serif for high readability and modern contrast.

sizes.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container max-width should be expansive, leaving room for asymmetrical image placements.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Editorial/Tetris grid. Avoid perfectly symmetrical 3-column layouts. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8 to create staggered masonry feels.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over center alignment. Mostly left-aligned heavy typography with right-aligned or staggered imagery.

motion_and_interaction.reveal: Framer motion staggered text reveals (words or characters sliding up from a hidden overflow container).
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Images should have a subtle parallax effect on scroll (using transform translateY based on scroll position).
motion_and_interaction.hover: Interactive image reveals on the Services list (e.g., hovering over '3DS Max' reveals a floating image). Buttons should have an elegant background fill animation.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Slow, organic editorial ribbon using serif font, e.g., 'SAISHRUTI ENTERPRISES — INTERIOR DESIGN — CIVIL CONTRACTOR' with massive gaps.

components.navigation: Sticky transparent nav that blurs (glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/70) on scroll. Simple text links, no heavy buttons.
components.hero: Full viewport height. Massive typography split across multiple lines, with an overlapping hero image that has a parallax scroll effect.
components.services: List-based layout (not cards). Massive font size for each service name, with a border-b separating them. On hover, show the relevant image or slide an arrow icon.
components.portfolio: Masonry or staggered asymmetrical layout. Images should not align perfectly on the horizontal axis.
components.testimonials: Editorial layout. A very large serif quote mark, oversized italicized text for the quote, and small sans-serif for the client name.
components.contact: Minimalist form using Shadcn. Inputs should have only border-b (flushed inputs) to look like a high-end editorial form rather than a typical SaaS boxed input.

hero_image.alt: Modern open-plan living area representing elegant interior design
hero_image.usage: Main hero section overlay or right-aligned parallax image

about_image.usage: Side image in the About section to anchor the 5-year story

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Install and use '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for all reveal animations, parallax, and micro-interactions.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for minimal, elegant icons.
Use Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit'. Update index.css to import these.
In Tailwind config, extend colors using the provided hex values under CSS variables.
The Contact form must collect Name, Email, Phone, Project Type, and Message, and implement a mock database save or form submission simulation.
Do NOT use the generic Shadcn 'Card' component with its borders for the design; build custom DOM structures that fit the editorial/asymmetrical layout.
For inputs in the contact form, style them with 'border-0 border-b border-black/20 rounded-none bg-transparent focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-black' to get the luxury editorial look.
